title: 高松宮記念の後に・有終バクシン！

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I did it! I won against Flower!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I didn't manage to score 1,000 lengths over her, but I think it's quite the impressive result!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What's the matter? Go on, praise me to your heart's content!
choice_data_list: I still wouldn't say you're perfect.
I still wouldn't say you're perfect.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh, even now?!
choice_data_list: You still have to win by 1,000 lengths.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You might have a point…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Um, I do have a question for you. It just, well, popped into my head right about now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Trainer… I don't suppose you're deceiving me?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Did you twitch just now?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yet this is our third year together, and I still haven't done any long-distance training.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I support your reasoning on wanting to perfect my speed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: However, as of late, I am beginning to have my doubts…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Training for speed will bring us closer to her dream. I trust that she wants that more than anyone. But…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If I can't convince her now, she could end up hurting herself in a race she can't handle yet. That's why I'll say…
choice_data_list: Let's try for a long-distance race!
Let's try for a long-distance race!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh… Whoooa?! Does… does that mean…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Is it finally my time to sweep the Twin Tenno Sho and take on the Arima Kinen?!
choice_data_list: First up is the G3 Hakodate Sprint Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh?!
choice_data_list: Then it's the G3 CBC Sho!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh!
choice_data_list: Lastly, we'll go for the G2 Centaur Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Aren't all of those races 1,200 meters?! None of them are even close to being long distance!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I knew it, Trainer, you are deceiving me—
choice_data_list: Not quite. You'll be competing in three races.
Not quite. You'll be competing in three races.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: …So? What does that change?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Gasp! You don't mean!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: …That's the same distance as the Stayers Stakes, the longest race in the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: So… if you add a bunch of 1,200-meter races together, it becomes a long-distance race?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: And if I place first in all of them… that'll mean I've won a 3,600-meter race!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'll definitely run my heart out! Your words are so profound!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I knew I could put my trust in you! I apologize for doubting you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I will run all three races! Long distance, short distance, I'll Bakushin right through them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …And that's how we decide our next race will be the Hakodate Sprint Stakes!
